Two player games I play with my girlfriend:

That's quite a list of games. I've been wanting to get Tsuro of the Seas, but wasn't sure that would play well for two. Also, if you don't mind me asking more questions, how do you like Dixit and Forbidden Desert?

Both games have been played on Wil Wheaton's Tabletop so if you want to get a feel for them those are good episodes to watch (but they do play Forbidden Desert horribly wrong).

Dixit is a nice party game, there's not much more to it than that. Pick a piece of art, say a few words about it, everyone else plays a piece of art they think will make other people choose it. If everyone guesses yours, you get no points, so you have to be purposely vague. It works better with more people, and I wouldn't recommend playing it with less than 5 people, but 4 is okay.

Forbidden Desert is my favorite pure co-op game. Like all Leacock games, it plays well with all amount of players, small or large. It plays up to 5, and has a difficulty slider. It has unique mechanics, and is constantly leaving me on the edge of my seat. I can't recommend it enough. It's one of the ten games I've ever rated a 9 or higher.

My suggestions (some repeats from other posts here, but I'd like to emphasize them):

  • Memoir 44 (WW2 tactical wargame, very easy to play, lots of fun; 2 players only, unless you do the crazy multiplayer thing)
  • Lost Cities (card game with a small board, great for passing time in airports - very "wife-friendly", whatever that means; 2 players only)
  • Marvel Legendary (superheroes, very casual and fun, for 2 or more)
  • Pathfinder Adventure Card Game (dungeons and dragons inspired, your character develops over a series of games, for 2 or more)
  • Dungeons and Dragons: Wrath of Ashardalon (feels more like a dungeon crawl than Pathfinder, but the characters don't improve between games)
  • Heroscape (discontinued, now it's really hard to find and expensive, but one of the best games ever)
  • Lords of Scotland (takes a few plays to "get", but it is a really good 2 player card game)
